title: FIDES: A Concordance Protocol for LLM-Generated Trading Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2608.23308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An LLM asked for a trading strategy returns three artifacts at once: a natural-language rationale, an executable implementation, and once run, a track record. Whether these are the same object is rarely checked. We present FIDES, a measurement protocol that treats them as three views to be reconciled rather than one deliverable to be graded. Through dual delivery, a single model call returns both a natural-language strategy with an explicit claimed edge and a self-contained strategy(df) function. FIDES executes the code in a sandbox against a lag-one out-of-sample backtest and scores three concordance gaps: say to do, do to real, and say to result.   On 8 liquid US ETFs across four models plus a two-stage elicitation arm, 40 strategies, 2023 to 2024 out-of-sample, three findings stand out. First, concordance does not predict profit: only 2 of 40 strategies beat buy-and-hold, and a plain sma(50,200) rule outperforms every model's mean S

translated_title: FIDES：一种用于LLM生成交易策略的一致性协议
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.23308v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当被要求提供交易策略时，一个LLM会同时返回三个产物：一个自然语言的理由、一个可执行的实现，以及一旦运行后的业绩记录。这些是否属于同一对象很少被检查。我们提出了FIDES，一种测量协议，将这三个产物视为需要协调的三个视图，而非一个需要评分的交付物。通过双重交付，一次模型调用同时返回一个带有明确声称优势的自然语言策略和一个自包含的strategy(df)函数。FIDES在沙盒中针对滞后一期样本外回测执行代码，并评分三个一致性差距：说到做到、做到真实、以及说到结果。在8个流动性美国ETF上，涵盖四种模型及一个两阶段引导分支，共40个策略，样本外期间为2023年至2024年，三个发现脱颖而出。首先，一致性不能预测利润：40个策略中只有2个击败了买入持有策略，而一个简单的sma(50,200)规则在平均S上优于所有模型。
tldr: 本文提出FIDES协议，通过协调LLM生成策略的语言、代码和业绩记录三个视图，发现一致性不能预测利润，且简单规则优于所有模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the FIDES protocol to reconcile the language, code, and performance views of LLM-generated strategies, finding that concordance does not predict profit and simple rules outperform all models.
